mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation exceeds 3.5%, the Federal Reserve initiates monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC remains negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) fails to predict positive returns with Rank IC > 0.05 in any 2-year rolling window, or the joint effect is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.5%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy to stimulate labor markets, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive returns with Rank IC > 0.05 in any 2-year rolling window, or correlation with SPX returns is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.5% year-over-year signals robust economic expansion, increasing corporate profitability and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL indicates imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * CPIAUCSL) fails to predict negative returns with Rank IC < -0.05 in any 2-year rolling window, or the effect is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In housing market booms (HOUST > 600), strong residential construction drives consumer confidence and spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 600, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
